text: Design life of the plant is per DP-CASE-0034; the structural design working life is 50 years (EN 1990 category 5) for buildings and main structures and 30 years minimum for replaceable items (pipe supports, cladding, non-structural elements), the concrete durability design being for 50 years (ER-13.04). Consequence class CC3 (EN 1990) applies to the power block structures, turbine foundations and the control and electrical building; CC2 to other structures.
